title: Works but Inefficient
text: Works but Inefficient. This works but is not easy to handle. The blades work well and cut my squash or zucchini just fine. The problem is with having to hold the thing in one hand and the cap that holds the veggie in the other, that you twist. It is hard to control and often times veggies will slip out of the thing or the spikes that are supposed to hold the veggie spin inside of it and mash it up.It takes quite a few spins before it starts to center but it's a shaky and unstable process. And if you have arthritis, tendinitis or some other bone or muscle or hand issue, this is going to kill being able to use this.
